1992 Olympic NBA all-stars who exported the league.

How Dream Team connects

  • Character: Michael Jordan — Michael Jordan starred on the 1992 Dream Team.
  • Character: Magic Johnson — Magic Johnson played on the 1992 Dream Team after HIV disclosure.
  • Topic: NBA — The Dream Team was the NBA's Olympic export.
  • Character: Larry Bird — Larry Bird was a 1992 Dream Team forward in the twilight of his career.
  • Character: David Stern — Stern's office helped turn NBA stars loose on the 1992 Olympics.

What is Dream Team?

The Dream Team was the 1992 U.S. Olympic squad of Jordan, Magic, Bird, and others — the first time NBA stars played the Games and sold the league abroad.

Key threads lead to Michael Jordan, Magic Johnson, NBA, Larry Bird and David Stern.
